propositions: Rebar CLI constructs command identity through overlapping frozensets and manual help resources causing parser/help drift and inconsistent --help output across 21 intercept-only commands
Every command grammar must be built by a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used identically by both runtime handlers and build-time generation to eliminate manual syntax authority
Runtime overview and help forms must read only committed generated package-help bytes before operation/config/mount or handler resolution to prevent pre-operation side effects

Exact, compatibility, hidden, and retired command spellings including jira-onboard, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, bridge-status, and purge-bridge must exhibit approved behavior with canonical argument definitions
Semantic capability registry must map capabilities to packaging extras and missing postures (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) without eager optional imports or domain-component coupling
CLI reference generation and coverage checks must derive from registries and parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command censuses
